text:
Root cause: `TTLCache.expire()` used a strict `>` comparison, so entries were retained until one timer tick after their TTL elapsed, while membership and iteration treated them as expired at the exact expiration time.

Changed the expiration condition to `>=`, making `len()`, `currsize`, membership, iteration, and `expire()` consistent. All targeted tests pass.

final_text:
Root cause: `TTLCache.expire()` used a strict `>` comparison, so entries were retained until one timer tick after their TTL elapsed, while membership and iteration treated them as expired at the exact expiration time.

Changed the expiration condition to `>=`, making `len()`, `currsize`, membership, iteration, and `expire()` consistent. All targeted tests pass.
